decisions.rationale: Supersedes the separate photograph card: the existing meadow now fills the hero stage and blends into ivory behind the copy and lower edge. The image is static; light, mist and three small motes provide optional ambient motion with pause, offscreen and reduced-motion safeguards. Duplicate photo caption and large floating reset card removed; existing destination retained as a compact link.

Replaces the rejected dark forest hero and painted pathway/support scenes with licensed real sunrise, bright workspace, blank journal, picnic connection, and light seating photographs. Ivory rather than black hero scrim; existing depth and motion controls unchanged. Stock scenes are not represented as MinSU facilities or patients.

Real licensed forest photography in a responsive locally hosted 4K WebP set, layered photo/caption/action depth, bounded fine-pointer perspective, actual document-scroll tracking, one-shot section reveals, and a motion pause control. Inspired by 21st Panoramic Spread Hero and Optimized Tilt Card metadata; no component code retrieved.
A writing-first Blade layout with the existing illustrated journal asset, warm paper typography, optional prompts, and compact recent reflections.
